instruction: Browse Marvel toys for kids and sort by lowest price.

metadata.explanation: Related brand (Marvel, which includes Spider-Man) with same category structure and sort order as original.
metadata.verification: Task uses existing check_direct_json_object metric and get_active_tab_html_parse getter. No custom functions needed. Evaluator checks breadcrumb navigation and URL parameters match expected product category and sort order.

Getter also checks URL parameters for Marvel/Toys/Kids/S=4 to verify browsing and sorting state
Metric (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares extracted values with expected values using exact matching
Expected values correctly specify: marvel=true, toys=true, kids=true, price low-high=true, is_other_exist=false
Complete coverage: verifies both navigation breadcrumb AND sort order selector AND URL parameters
Logic will work correctly at runtime - getter uses category='class&url' which handles both HTML class elements and URL parsing
No structural issues - uses official getter and metric functions without modifications
